definition.ci95: mean +- t_{0.975, n-1} * sd / sqrt(n) with n = 3 training seeds, df = 2, t = 4.302653. Wide by construction; seeds are the unit, episodes are pooled inside each value
definition.drop: R2(encoder tokens, step k) - R2(rollout, step k), same probe, role-pooled (002 H_b drop uses role 'unseen' at the last step)
definition.a_minus_b: welch: diff of means with Welch-Satterthwaite t interval (no pairing); paired_by_seed_index: differences of seed s of (a) and seed s of (b), t interval df = n-1. Pairing by seed index is a convention only
definition.order_accuracy: exp002 stats.pair_order_accuracy: fraction of cross-level episode pairs whose predicted order equals the true level order; mean over probe seeds; point estimate
